import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivFamilyLocalEquation
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.TensorObjSubstrate.TrivialisationRestrict

/-!
# Restriction of a divisor-family chart quotient

The quotient used by a chart is the restriction of the normalized quotient
`pullbackUnitIso.inv ≫ x.q`, transported across the canonical unit and
restriction/pullback isomorphisms.  This is the small bridge needed when a
kernel calculation is made on an open chart and then read in ambient sections.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily

variable {S X : Scheme.{u}} {π : X ⟶ S} {T : Over S}

/- The quotient with its source identified with the unit on `pullback π T.hom`. -/
noncomputable def normalizedQuotient (x : DivFamily π T) :
    SheafOfModules.unit (pullback π T.hom).ringCatSheaf ⟶ x.F :=
  (Modules.pullbackUnitIso (pullback.fst π T.hom)).inv ≫ x.q

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- The chart quotient is the normalized quotient restricted to the chart,
with the canonical unit and restriction/pullback comparisons inserted. -/
theorem chartQuotient_eq_restrict_normalized (x : DivFamily π T)
    (U : (pullback π T.hom).Opens) :
    chartQuotient x U =
      (Modules.unitRestrictIso U.ι).inv ≫
        (Modules.restrictFunctor U.ι).map (normalizedQuotient x) ≫
          (Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.app x.F := by
  simp only [chartQuotient, chartSourceIso, normalizedQuotient,
    Modules.unitRestrictIso, Iso.trans_inv, Iso.trans_hom, Functor.mapIso_inv,
    Functor.mapIso_hom, Category.assoc]
  have hnat := (Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).inv.naturality
    (normalizedQuotient x)
  have hcong := congrArg
    (fun z => (Modules.pullbackUnitIso U.ι).inv ≫ z ≫
      (Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.app x.F) hnat.symm
  simpa only [normalizedQuotient, Functor.map_comp, Category.assoc,
    Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_app, Iso.app_inv, Category.comp_id] using hcong.symm

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
/-- Sectionwise form of `chartQuotient_eq_restrict_normalized`. -/
theorem chartQuotient_app_eq_restrict_normalized_app
    (x : DivFamily π T) (U : (pullback π T.hom).Opens)
    (V : (U : Scheme).Opens) :
    (chartQuotient x U).val.app (op V) =
      ((Modules.unitRestrictIso U.ι).inv ≫
        (Modules.restrictFunctorIsoPullback U.ι).hom.app
          (SheafOfModules.unit (pullback π T.hom).ringCatSheaf) ≫
        (Modules.pullback U.ι).map (normalizedQuotient x)).val.app (op V) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun φ => φ.val.app (op V))
    (chartQuotient_eq_restrict_normalized x U)
  simpa [Modules.Hom.comp_app] using h

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.DivFamily
